title: Djokovic Loses in Shanghai Just Days After a Big Win
summary:
Tennis star Novak Djokovic had a surprise loss at the Shanghai Masters in China. It came just three days after he won the China Open in Beijing.

Hubert Hurkacz of Poland beat Djokovic 6-4, 6-3 in 87 minutes. It was the first time Hurkacz had ever beaten him. Djokovic had won all eight of their earlier matches.

"It's a special night," Hurkacz said. He called Djokovic a legend and said it was a pleasure to play him.

Djokovic was tired from a busy stretch. This was his sixth match in 10 days. In Beijing, the 39-year-old won the 102nd title of his career. Djokovic holds the men's record of 24 Grand Slam titles.

Now Djokovic hopes to play in the ATP Finals, a special event for the top eight players at the end of the season. He is ninth in the race right now, so he needs to play well at the Paris Masters in November.
why_it_matters: It shows that even the best players can lose, and that hard work can pay off for someone who keeps trying.
